I) IMPORTANT DATES:
I Submission of Online Forms/ Hard Copy from 17th November, 2026
II Last date for Submission of Online Forms 16th December, 2026 upto 4.00 p.m.
III Last date for submission of Hard copy 23rd December, 2026
UNIVERSITY OF KASHMIR
[NAAC Accredited Grade “A++”]
University Campus, Hazratbal, Srinagar (J&K)- 190006
www.kashmiruniversity.net
II) QUALIFICATIONS AND OTHER ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS:
A. For the post of ASSOCIATE PROFESSOR unless mention elsewhere in this
Advertisement:
(i) A good academic record with a Ph.D. Degree in the concerned/ allied/relevant
disciplines.
(ii) A Master’s Degree with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point scale,
wherever grading system is followed)
(iii) A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an
academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University,
College or Accredited Research Institution/Industry with a minimum of seven
publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC listed journals and a total Research score
of seventy five (75) as per the criteria given in Appendix II, Table 2 of UGC
Guidelines, July, 2018.
B. For the post of Associate Professor, Iqbal Institute of Culture and Philosophy
(i) Good academic record with a Ph.D. Degree in Urdu/Persian/Arabic/Islamic
Studies/Philosophy.
(ii) A Master’s Degree in Urdu/Persian/Arabic/Islamic Studies/ Philosophy with at
least 55% marks or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever grading system is
followed.
(iii) Published Research work of good quality on any aspect of Iqbal studies.
(iv) A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an
academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University,
College or Accredited Research Institution/Industry with a minimum of seven
publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC listed journals and a total Research score
of seventy five (75) as per the criteria given in Appendix II, Table 2 of UGC
Guidelines, July, 2018.
D. For the post of Associate Professor, Centre for Sheikh-ul-Aalam Studies (Social Science/
Languages)
(i) Good academic record with a Ph.D Degree in any discipline of Social Sciences /
Languages.
(ii) A Master’s Degree in any of the disciplines of Social Sciences or Languages with at
least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever grading system is
followed).
(iii) Published Research work of good quality on any aspect of Kashmiri Culture,
History, Religion or Philosophy, preferably relevant to Reshi Movement/ Spiritual
tradition/identity of Kashmir.
(iv) A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an
academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University,
College or Accredited Research Institution/Industry with a minimum of seven
publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC listed journals and a total Research score
of seventy five (75) as per the criteria given in Appendix II, Table 2 of UGC
Guidelines, July, 2018.
III) PERCENTAGE EQUIVALENCE OF GRADE POINTS FOR A SEVEN POINT
SCALE:
In the Seven Point Scale with letter grades O, A, B, C, D, E & F, “B” shall be regarded as
equivalent of 55%, wherever the grading system is followed:-

www.kashmiruniversity.net

A relaxation of 5% may be provided from 55% to 50% of the marks to the Ph.D. Degree holders, who
have obtained their Master’s Degree prior to 19th September, 1991.
IV) SUBMISSION OF ON-LINE APPLICATION FORMS:
Step 1: Visit http://www.kashmiruniversity.ac.in and Click on Jobs/Recruitment link.
Read detailed important Instructions and Preview of whole process for
Registration and submission of Application Form before proceeding ahead.
Step 2: Candidate needs to register himself/herself before submitting the Online
Application. For Registration, Click on the Register as an Applicant link.
Remember the Username and Password for future reference. Use valid Email id
and mobile during registration process.
Step 3: After successful Registration, Login into the system by using your Username and
Password.
Step 4: Key in the personal details, educational qualifications, experience etc then
Preview the Form. If details are correct, Click on Submit. If there are variations or
you want to update, Click on Preview button, make corrections, updating and
then Submit. Remember, no editing or updating is allowed after the Form is
submitted. Get a print out and note the Form No. for future reference.
Step 5: Select payment for depositing Application Fee (Online mode only). Deposit the
Application Fee of Rs. 1050/-, through Online mode through online banking
/Credit/Debit card.
V) SUBMISSION OF DOWNLOADED APPLICATION FORMS (HARD COPY)
Submit a Print-out of the Application Form submitted online along with the enclosures, duly
numbered at right hand top margin, as per the auto-generated serial numbers against each
entry, online payment acknowledgement, properly bound, either personally or through Speed
Post/Registered Post to the Deputy Registrar (Recruitment), Administrative Block, University
Campus, Hazratbal, Srinagar-190006, J&K.
Candidates sending print-out of their Application Forms by post should ensure that the
envelope containing Application Form is super-scribed as “Application for the post of
………………………, Post ID ………… Advertisement notice No. ………. Dated ………….”
and reaches by or before the last date. Application Form received by post after the last date
shall be rejected summarily without any notice in this regard.
VI) OTHER CONDITIONS:
a. For the post of Associate Professor, a candidate should have a minimum of seven
publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC listed journals and a total Academic/ Research
score of seventy five (75) as per the criteria given in Appendix II, Table 2 of UGC Guidelines,
July, 2018.
b. Any publications in predatory/dubious journals or presentations in predatory/dubious
conferences shall not be considered for academic credit for selection and confirmation.
With effect from 14.6.2019, research publications from journals indexed in UGC-CARE
Listed Journals/ Scopus/ Web of Science listed Journals only would be considered for all
academic purposes.
UNIVERSITY OF KASHMIR
[NAAC Accredited Grade “A++”]
University Campus, Hazratbal, Srinagar (J&K)- 190006
www.kashmiruniversity.net
c. Each API score must be supported by the documentary evidence in the Performance Based
Appraisal System (PBAS) Proforma, without which no claim on account of Academic/
Research Score will be entertained. It is mandatory that the candidate mark Page No./s on
all the supporting documents as in the Application Form.
d. The details with regard to ISSN/ISBN, sole author/Coauthors/Joint publication,
refereed/non-refereed/ indexed/ non-indexed and local/ national/ international status etc.
must also be reflected in the publication part of PBAS proforma supported by documentary
evidence.
e. Documents required to be submitted along with Hard Copy of complete application form:
i. One (1) set of Performance Based Appraisal System (PBAS) Proforma, four (04)
copies of latest Bio-data along with and four (04) copies of seven (07) best
publications as books and / or research/policy papers (which shall not be in any case
attached to PBAS Proforma), in spiral binding only, along with other documents.
f. Candidates who have been awarded post graduate/Ph.D. degree from Foreign University
should enclose “Equivalence Certificate” issued by Association of Indian Universities (AIU),
New Delhi without which their candidature shall not be considered and application form
shall be rejected.
g. Terms and conditions of appointment of the candidates shall be governed by the provisions
of the Kashmir & Jammu Universities Act, 1969, and Statutes & Regulations made there
under from time to time, University Grants Commission and the Union Ministry of
Education, wherever applicable.
h. Where the University does not have its own service rules, those prescribed by the
Government of the UT for its employees are, mutatis mutandis, applicable to the University
employees also.
i. Only those candidates should apply for the posts, who fulfill the eligibility criteria on or
before the last date of receipt of applications.
j. The University reserves the right not to fill up any of the vacancies advertised, if
circumstances so warrant, without assigning any reason thereof.
k. The number of vacancies indicated in Advertisement notice is tentative. The University
reserves the right to increase/decrease the number of posts at the time of Selection.
l. Candidates selected for appointment will be placed on probation for one or two years as per
recommendations of the Selection Committee.
m. Canvassing in any form by or on behalf of the candidate will be a disqualification.
n. Impersonation or submission of false/fabricated/tampered documents or making
incorrect/false statements by a candidate, will, in addition to debarring him/her
permanently or for a specific period from any employment in the University and also render
him/her liable for criminal prosecution.
o. The candidates shall have to produce the original documents relating to their age,
qualifications, experience, fitness and other claims whatsoever at the time of interview. The
selected candidates shall also be required to produce the said documents before joining the
post to which they are appointed.
p. No TA/DA shall be paid to the candidates for appearing in the interview.
q. The candidates are advised to write their name strictly as per Matriculation/Higher
Secondary Certificates.
r. During the period of probation, the candidate shall be required to make consistent efforts for
bringing out the quality publications in UGC-CARE Journals with ISSN Number etc. Besides
pursuing research work of tangible standards and will be required to take one Research
Project in the area of their specialization.
s. The PWD candidates shall be provided horizontal reservation as per the Government
Guidelines wherever PWD candidates are available.
t. EWS indicates that the position is for EWS category only. However, since EWS vacancies are
not to be carried forward to the next recruitment year as backlog, as such, in case EWS
candidate/s are not available/ found suitable, the said position/s shall be filled by the
University under UR category. As such, UR candidtaes can also apply on their own risk and
responsibility against the EWS category and their candidature shall be considered only in
case of non-availability/ non-suitability of EWS candidates.
UNIVERSITY OF KASHMIR
[NAAC Accredited Grade “A++”]
University Campus, Hazratbal, Srinagar (J&K)- 190006
www.kashmiruniversity.net
VII) GENERAL INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Applications by Government servants should be sent through the Administrative Authority
concerned. In the case of the University Teachers/Employees, through the Registrar of their
respective University and in the case of persons employed in the private firms and
Institutions through the Head of the firm/institutions concerned. APPLICATIONS NOT
ROUTED THROUGH THE RESPECTIVE CHANNELS ARE LIABLE TO BE REJECTED.
However such candidates are advised not to wait for the last date and an advance copy may
be sent at the earliest followed by application through proper channel.
2. Applications received late or incomplete in any respect shall not be entertained.
3. Candidates are advised to regularly check the University website for latest
updates/important instructions, released by the University from time to time.
4. Candidates shall be informed regarding interview through E-mail/SMS registered at the
time of Registration. However, the University shall not be responsible for non-delivery of
E-mail/SMS due to technical or any other issues.
5. All enclosures attached with the Application Form should be self attested and attached in
the same order as of the Serial Number generated against each entry. Incomplete
Application Forms and without enclosures shall be rejected.
6. The University shall verify the character and antecedents of all the candidates and
documents submitted by them at any time of appointment or during the tenure of service.
In case, it is detected that the documents submitted are fake or the candidate has a
clandestine antecedents/background and has suppressed the said information, his/her
services shall be terminated forthwith/ ab-initio and the action shall be taken as warranted
under rules.
7. Addendum/ Corrigendum/ Notice to this advertisement shall be uploaded on the
university website only. As such, Candidates are advised to regularly check University
website for latest updates/important instructions, released by the University from time to
time. No separate/ individual intimation in this regard shall be given.
8. Candidate/s desirous to submit application form in more than one category shall have to
apply separately for each category, subject to fulfilment of eligibility conditions.
9. This is subject to the outcome of writ petition(s) if any, pending before any competent court
of law.
Sd/-
Deputy Registrar
